content: After the tree is constructed, we can compute the overall phrasal representation in a bottom-up manner, guided by the labels of leaf and internal nodes. We note that the emphasis of this work is not to compute sentence-level representations. This goal has been explored in recent research BIBREF17 , BIBREF18 , and combining our models with methods presented therein for sentence-level representations is straightforward.
